description: One market's recent price path as a summary, not raw candles: open, high, low, current, change, volume, realised volatility and a short sparkline, in YES probability points (0-100). Takes a Kalshi ticker or an instrument id; for an instrument the numbers price the instrument's YES.

ref.description: A Kalshi ticker, an instrument id (ins_...) or an Arena slug.

name: get_price_history
title: Price history summary
